designs.title: 余烬·双子
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished fantasy game weapon illustration of ONE GEMINI zodiac BOW for an existing geometric luminous bow collection. Landscape 3:2 concept plate, charcoal-black background. LEFT 60 percent: large complete bow tip-to-tip with a single taut bowstring, generous margins, near-side view with subtle depth. RIGHT 40 percent: detailed enlarged three-quarter view of the SAME grip and limb roots, plus local particle effect concept around it. Clearly match full bow to close-up. Strong thick geometric solid-light construction, simple repeated shapes, carefully bevelled broad faces, darker colored main planes and slender fluorescent edges with RESTRAINED bloom. No metal, leather, rock crystals, gem settings, filigree, people, hands, faces, horn shapes or star/hexagram seals. Gemini identity is expressed by paired structures, duality, mirroring and intertwined geometric components, not a giant symbol pasted on a generic bow. One substantial comfortable palm-length grip with unobstructed hand space and arrow passage. A beautiful distinctive central silhouette seamlessly develops into the limbs. Show actual thickness, intentional negative spaces, lucid buildable structure, no hair-thin wire body. Spell the small Chinese title exactly as provided, bottom of the plate, no other text. Do not add stats, interface, borders, watermarks or a cluttered scene. Particles are localized accents, do not obscure the grip or wash the bow into white; no giant circular screen-filling aura. Title: "余烬·双子". COLOR scarlet red with rose-red edge accents. DESIGN twin angular blades: each limb has two strong parallel rails separated by a clean narrow gap, one carrying short forward-swept triangular fins and the other backward-swept complementary fins; the paired repeating shapes form an alternating chevron rhythm that shrinks toward the tips. Broad assertive recurved silhouette. GRIP a faceted near-straight solid waist; upper and lower ends flare into two stacked offset trapezoid shoulders at different depths, with a short sharply cornered triangular aperture above and below the hand. Paired small angular ribs interlock into these shoulders without crossing the hand. Compact and powerful, distinct from a rounded leaf-shaped central loop. PARTICLE concept: two thin clusters of red and rose triangular sparks approach the grip from opposite limb roots, mixed with a handful of short ember streaks; tiny concentrated glow at convergence without any emblem or disc.
